retrievalProfile.description: A dreamy, pastel-toned composition featuring a central figure in white standing amidst a dense floral foreground against a soft gradient sunset sky with glowing serif typography.
triggerTerms: man in white standing in flowers
excludeWhen: dark or moody themes are requested
urban or industrial settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male figure in all-white attire stands in profile, looking downward, positioned within a lush bed of pink and white roses. The background consists of a soft, hazy pink and orange sunset sky. The overall image has a film-like grain and a soft-focus glow, with elegant white serif typography floating at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically between a dense floral base and expansive sky.
Monochromatic white clothing contrasting against warm pastel background tones.
Typography integrated into the upper third, utilizing negative space in the sky.
Soft lighting creating a halo effect around the subject and text.
coreInvariants: Pastel pink and peach color palette
Dense floral foreground covering the bottom fifth of the frame
Soft film grain and light leaks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject centered horizontally, scaled to occupy the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white clothing acts as the primary light anchor against the pink sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the glowing white text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows the body down to the floral bed.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper two-thirds of the sky to allow for typographic breathing room.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value (brightness) creating a washed-out, dreamy effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh blacks or primary blues

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Slightly condensed proportions for display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized secondary words to create rhythm
Tight kerning for a sophisticated editorial look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the main title paired with wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for peripheral details.
graphicDevices: Vertical text along the left margin

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast elegance for the display title.
Clean geometric look for the peripheral metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in all-white clothing standing in a field of pink and white roses. The background is a soft, hazy pastel pink and orange sunset sky. Apply a film grain texture and a soft-focus glow to the entire scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in a white Modern Serif font in the upper third of the image. Add a soft outer glow to the text. Place small, wide-tracked sans-serif text vertically along the left edge and horizontally in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a soft pastel pink/orange gradient?
Is the subject wearing all white?
Is there a dense floral foreground?
Is the main title a high-contrast serif font?
Is there a visible film grain texture?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the sunset orange vs pink
Amount of film grain and glow
mustRedesign: Do not include specific artist names or brand logos
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of subject and environment

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the sky
Ensure the floral bed looks natural and lush
Verify the white clothing isn't blown out (losing detail)
Confirm the film grain is subtle and not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure in white + floral foreground + pastel sunset sky + high-contrast serif typography + soft glow filter.
